Text: Okay... still standing. Let's see what's in here.
Hang on... did that thing just move?
Oh! A visitor. Give me a second... it's been quiet here.
I'm Orbit. You look like you've had quite a walk.
A whole moon, and you found the one place with a pull up bar. I think we'll get along.
Here's the idea. Choose a station, show me a short clip, and we'll look at it together.
Your first mission? Finish one review, then step out of the station. That's when it counts.
Reviews power this place. Your first five active days earn energy. Rest days are okay... we'll keep the rules in your journal.
And if I'm talking too much, your sound and comfort controls are right up there.
All right. Hold on a moment... I'm looking through your clip.
I've got a few things we can look at. Let's take them one at a time.
Hmm. I can't see enough to be useful here. Let's try a clearer angle.
There we go. First review complete. Take a breath... I'll save this in your journal.
